title: AI Was Reportedly Used to Create a Nonconsensual Pornographic Video Depicting a Bhutanese Woman in New Zealand
summary: A pornographic video with the face of a Bhutanese woman living in New Zealand superimposed using AI was reportedly posted online without her consent. She described embarrassment and psychological distress. After contacting police in Bhutan and New Zealand, she said she used StopNCII.org, a service for limiting nonconsensual intimate-image sharing, and could no longer find the video online.
